messages.subject: CFA sum scores (z-values)
parts:
Hello,
I am relatively new with R and lavaan so maybe it seems to be a silly question (I am Sorry!), but I am really interested in a code for the individual sum scores (not the factor scores!), is there an easy code for getting these in z-values or do I have to sum up all the equations with factor loadings, etc.?
Thanks very much in advance!
Esther

messages.author: d9ced0277ffec420
messages.subject: Re: CFA sum scores (z-values)
parts:
the rowSums() and scale() functions will do this for you, e.g., if your indicator variables are named Q1, Q2, Q3, and Q4:

indicator.vars <- c("Q1","Q2","Q3","Q4")
data$summed.score <- rowSums(data[indicator.vars])
data$summed.score.Z <- scale(data$summed.score)

Best,

Alex
